title: Life
excerpt:
When life hits you,
you learn a lesson every time.
When life pulls you down
Always remember there's a force,
pushing you up.

Every up and down we go through;
someone is broken,
someone is healing,

someone is learning
while someone is losing.
Some see failure in life and-
some get success.

In this life,
some become true, and,
some become fake,
we all are waiting for the right time,
to see that brightness in our life.

Life is getting hard,
life is getting tough,
remember there's always a lessons to learn.
